title: Conectores formales: a lo largo de, a raíz de

sections.content: A lo largo de introduces a span of time or space something happened across ("throughout"), and a raíz de introduces a cause ("as a result of"). Both are staples of formal historical writing. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A lo largo del imperio inca, miles de huacas formaban una red de sitios sagrados conectados por líneas imaginarias llamadas ceques.
items.english: Throughout the Inca empire, thousands of huacas formed a network of sacred sites connected by imaginary lines called ceques.

items.spanish: A raíz de esta especialización, perder a los escribas de una ciudad significaba perder también buena parte del conocimiento acumulado.
items.english: As a result of this specialization, losing a city's scribes also meant losing much of its accumulated knowledge.

items.spanish: A lo largo de su reinado, cada emperador mexica consultaba constantemente a estos sacerdotes antes de tomar decisiones importantes.
items.english: Throughout his reign, each Mexica emperor constantly consulted these priests before making important decisions.

items.spanish: A raíz de ese redescubrimiento, los historiadores empezaron a estudiar en profundidad la medicina indígena prehispánica.
items.english: As a result of that rediscovery, historians began studying pre-Hispanic indigenous medicine in depth.

sections.content: A lo largo de takes a stretch — a reign, an empire, a period — and says something held true across the whole of it. A raíz de takes an event and says something changed because of it. Neither implies a value judgement, unlike a pesar de (despite) — they're the two workhorse connectors for plain description.
